clippy_exception_scope: pre-existing frozen R29 diagnostic harness uses more than seven arguments
frozen R31 diagnostic harness uses variant % 2 == 0 and was not mutated after baseline

mechanisms: GroundedClaimIR records claim kind, proposition, epistemic status, support status, evidence references, source turns, verification state, and non-authority flags.
EvidenceGroundedRealizationIR binds the exact emitted text to its typed claim set with a deterministic SHA-256 seal.
Plan claims cite the structural plan hash and goal ID and remain PLANNED rather than observed.
Language reports cite the action and report turn and remain REPORTED_ONLY.
Verified execution claims require typed host receipt identifiers already accepted by ActionStateLedgerIR.
Discourse, temporal, dialogue-relation, and guard claims are projected from their existing evidence IR rather than inferred from output prose.
Missing results become explicit EVIDENCE_ABSENCE claims rather than fabricated outcomes.
Greetings, gratitude, clarification, feedback, and other dialogue-management responses are NON_FACTUAL interaction claims.
All claims carry at least one source turn; all factual or absence claims carry at least one evidence reference.
The realization layer never reparses its own natural-language output into semantic authority.
next_program_order: cross-axis integration of grammar, discourse, reference, pragmatics, action state, and realization
longer multi-speaker discourse and tool-specific result payload provenance
residual_limits: This is a bounded deterministic Language Cortex, not unrestricted GPT-level language competence.
The claim seal proves internal consistency and tamper evidence, not the truth of an external source.
Open-domain paraphrase, implicature, humor, repair, bridging reference, and long multi-speaker discourse remain incomplete.
Tool-specific structured result payloads need dedicated provenance extractors before their facts can be realized.
Cryptographic executor identity remains outside the trusted typed receipt boundary.
